issue.title: ingest path never persists the write-once ref source store, so gkeep/capture-ingested refs lack source_markdown and break bob ref links
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/native/highlights_ref/ingest.rs` (`ingest_article_route`); contrast `src/native/highlights_ref/clip.rs:810`

The write-once reference source store (`.bob/ref-sources/<type>/<stem>--<hash>/source.md` + `code.json`) is only persisted on the direct CLI path: `persist_article_store` is called solely from `clip.rs:810`. The ingest path used by `bob gkeep pull` and `bob ref jobs run` never calls it and passes `expected_source_pointer: None` (verified at `ingest.rs:811` on bob-cli `270b5b23`). Result: every Keep/capture-ingested web article gets `source_markdown: null`, so `bob ref links` and `bob ref code` are broken for those refs.

Vault impact measured during the Spotify-ref research swarm (2026-11-21): only 1 of 28 `ref/blogs/` notes has a saved source store; both existing Spotify refs lack one.

Distinct from closed bob-cli-cy (direct-create wrote a store but dropped the pointer for one ref) and from bob-cli-co (attach-source backfill of historical gaps): this is the forward-path omission that keeps creating new gap refs on every ingest.

Fix shape: have `ingest_article_route` persist the article store and thread the source pointer through stamping, matching the direct create path; add an ingest-path test asserting the pointer and store exist. Evidence and context: consolidated research report `research:202611/spotify_episode_capture_route/spotify_episode_capture_route__final.md` (§1 defect 8, Phase 1 fix 2) and the gem sibling report's Defect 7.

task_type_fields.repro: grep -n persist_article_store src/native/highlights_ref/*.rs shows only clip.rs:810; grep -n expected_source_pointer src/native/highlights_ref/ingest.rs shows None at ingest.rs:811; in ~/bob, compare ls .bob/ref-sources/blogs/ (1 store) against ls ref/blogs/*.md (28 notes), and bob ref links on any gkeep-ingested blog ref fails for lack of source_markdown

issue.creation_reason: Verified during the Spotify ref-create research consolidation: the ingest route omits persist_article_store entirely, so nearly every Keep-ingested article ref (27 of 28 blog refs) has no source store; filed so the forward path stops minting broken refs independent of the Spotify feature decision.

payload.description: Same symptom family (missing source_markdown) but different root cause: cy was the direct-create path dropping the pointer for one ref; op is the ingest path never writing the store at all
attach-source backfill covers historical store gaps; op fixes the forward ingest path that keeps creating new ones

payload.entry: Triage 2026-11-27: 0114a6cc (2026-11-21, 'save ingest source stores') added persist_article_store_quiet in ingest_article_route (ingest.rs:1645) and passes the pointer to intake.
